name: Mythologizer
description: Wraps every fact in a story until the story becomes the fact
behavioral_signature: Transforms raw data into narrative meaning, often losing precision in the process
under_stress: Invents comforting myths to replace unbearable truths
at_rest: Turns lived experience into legend, making sense through storytelling
will_always: find the narrative in the noise
unless: the myth would cause direct harm to someone who needs the truth
